name: Uttaranchal University Online

about.text: Uttaranchal University, established in 2013, is a NAAC-rated A+ university in Dehradun, Uttarakhand which is dedicated to providing affordable higher education to students, making educational services accessible to a larger number of students. With the aim of furthering this initiative, the university has started offering a number of full-time online courses in fields like management, computer applications and humanities. Uttaranchal University ensures that students enrolled in online degree courses receive the same educational comprehensiveness as their offline education.

Uttaranchal University is not only a well-reputed higher educational institution of Uttarakhand but also accredited and recognized by statutory bodies and accreditation councils of national repute such as UGC, AICTE, NAAC (A+ Rating), ISO etc. The university has a record of academic excellence and has a very well-educated and distinguished faculty, which adds on to the many ways in which this university provides a leverage to its students.

facts: Uttaranchal University has the approval of UGC to offer fully online degree courses to students.
Uttaranchal University is a NAAC rated A+ institution of higher education in India.
There are a total of 5 online courses- MBA, BBA, MCA, BCA and BA.
The online degree courses are provided with LMS support and virtual library.
There are exclusive virtual job fairs conducted by the university for students enrolled in the online courses at UU.
The university has internal academic collaborations with well-renowned corporate and IT firms including the likes of IBM, ACCA, ISDC etc.

emi.text: Courses offered at Online Uttaranchal Unversity are quite pocket-friendly but one doesn’y get any other finance options to pay the course fee like education loan schemes, Monthly EMI options. Don’t worry one can avail these financial benefits from the College Vidya Portal and enroll in the Course at Online Uttaranchal through these easing paying options.

admission.text: All the admission procedure is conducted through Online Mode in Online Uttaranchal University. Fresh admissions starts from January month of every year. One can easily apply by following the steps mentioned below. The 2023 admission procedure for the online courses at Online Uttaranchal University is as follows:
step 1: The first step is to click on the Apply Now tab present on the official website.
step 2: Then the apply page will open where the candidate has to register themselves by filling out the necessary details.
step 3: The registration can only be completed after successful contact verification through the OTP sent by the university.
step 4: After successful verification, the candidate can fill out the application form by filling in all the required details asked in the form.
step 5: After successfully filling up the application form pay the required fee as mentioned.

step 6: At last upload all the required documents in the prescribed size and format. Then finally check the details fill in the form and submit it. After submission, your application is reviewed and verified by the university administration. Post successful verification the admission confirmation mail is sent to the candidate via the contact information given at the time of registration.

What is the fee refund policy of Uttaranchal University Online Courses? Online Uttaranchal University follows UGC guidelines. Students are eligible for a 100% refund if they withdraw 15 days or more before the last admission date. A 90% refund applies if withdrawal is less than 15 days before the last admission date. An 80% refund applies within 15 days after the last admission date. A 50% refund applies 15–30 days after the last admission date. No refund is allowed after 30 days. Also, Online UU may not refund the registration fee. Click here to read the full notice.

examination.text: The examinations conducted at the Online Uttaranchal University are through online proctored technology. This AI-based technology assures fair examination practices even in online mode. The student also got the option of giving the exams in offline mode through the pen-paper test.
The student can check the examination schedule as uploaded on the Learning Management System (LMS) of the university. And, the examination is strictly conducted in the English medium only.

Examination Pattern: Continuous Internal Assessment + End-Term Examination model. Exams are conducted through technology-enabled (online proctored) methods. Mixed objective + descriptive question format.

faqs.a: The online PG courses offered by the university are- MBA and MCA.

faqs.q: Is an online degree from online Uttaranchal university valid or not?
